mutations.name: a workflow-ci NO_REPRO wakes the fixer again
kills: a workflow-only NO_REPRO on a held PR read behind with green checks (TP-4109, tp#2325) wakes no fixer at r0 or at r1 after main moved, and asks the owner a waivable send-back at each head

mutations.name: the workflow-ci gate offers no waive-proof
mutations.find: after a workflow-only NO_REPRO", prompt, true);
mutations.replace: after a workflow-only NO_REPRO", prompt, false);
kills: a workflow-only NO_REPRO on a held PR read behind with green checks (TP-4109, tp#2325) wakes no fixer at r0 or at r1 after main moved, and asks the owner a waivable send-back at each head

mutations.name: any NO_REPRO skips the fixer, not only a workflow-ci read
kills: a workflow-only NO_REPRO on a held PR read behind with green checks (TP-4109, tp#2325) still wakes the fix-proof fixer for a NO_REPRO that is no workflow-ci read

mutations.name: a replay ignores the fixer wake its record holds
kills: a workflow-ci NO_REPRO recorded before TP-4109 replays the fixer wake it recorded, and asks the gate live or where the record asked it
